backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing e-commerce backend with product management (fashion/jewellery categories), user authentication (session tokens with 24h expiration), role-based access control, and Amazon product metadata extraction via HTML parsing with priority-based field extraction.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms old session data (without expiresAt) to new format with 24-hour expiration timestamps and initializes empty users map while discarding deprecated authenticatedAdmins map.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: replacing hardcoded admin credentials with secure registration, implementing token-based session management with expiration, and updating AdminLogin UI to support registration and backend authentication.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of frontend components including routing, authentication hooks, product management with hierarchical categories, admin panels, and Amazon product metadata extraction with HTML parsing validation.
frontend/CLOUDFLARE_CDN_SETUP.md: Step-by-step guide for configuring Cloudflare CDN optimizations including auto-minify, Brotli compression, Rocket Loader, caching rules, image optimization (Polish/WebP), HTTP/3, Early Hints, and mobile-specific settings with verification and monitoring instructions.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Deployment troubleshooting guide documenting production failure caused by missing favicon reference, providing resolution steps, and comprehensive go-live checklist covering static assets, build verification, service worker registration, visual checks, functionality testing, and common issues with solutions.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point with extensive SEO meta tags, Open Graph/Twitter cards, structured data for organization schema, resource hints for performance, and preloading of critical assets (logo and hero banner).
frontend/PERFORMANCE_ACTION_PLAN.md: Performance optimization action plan targeting 90+ mobile and 95+ desktop Lighthouse scores through phased approach addressing JavaScript bundle size, image optimization, render-blocking resources, resource hints, layout shifts, and Cloudflare CDN configuration.
frontend/PERFORMANCE_OPTIMIZATION.md: Comprehensive documentation of performance optimizations implemented to achieve PageSpeed scores >85, covering critical path rendering, image optimization, code splitting, service workers, Core Web Vitals tracking, and React Query configuration.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Standard robots.txt file allowing all user agents to crawl the site and referencing the sitemap location.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap with a single entry for the homepage, marked with daily change frequency and priority 1.0.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets, network-first for HTML/API calls, with versioned caching and cleanup of old caches on activation.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component with route handling, lazy-loaded admin/blog components, authentication state management, and conditional rendering of HomePage, ProductsPage, AdminPage, SitemapPage, or 404 page.
frontend/src/components/admin/BlogManage: Placeholder component displaying a message that blog management functionality has been removed from this version.
frontend/src/components/admin/Newsletter: Placeholder component displaying a message that newsletter management functionality has been removed from this version.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductMan: Admin interface for CRUD operations on products with form validation, category management (fashion/jewellery), and dialogs for adding, editing, and deleting products using backend mutations.
frontend/src/components/admin/SitePagesM: Placeholder component displaying a message that site pages management functionality has been removed from this version.
frontend/src/components/AdminLogin.tsx: Admin authentication modal supporting both custom username/password login and Internet Identity, with registration flow including password strength validation and confirmation matching.
frontend/src/components/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin dashboard with tabbed interface for managing products, blog, newsletter, and site pages, including logout functionality for both custom auth and Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/AmazonBanner.tsx: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/BlogPostModal.ts: Dialog component that displays a message indicating blog functionality has been removed from this version.
frontend/src/components/BlogTeaser.tsx: Memoized component that returns null, effectively hiding the blog teaser section as blog functionality has been removed.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with newsletter subscription form (currently disabled), social media links, quick navigation links, trust badges, and affiliate disclosure. Includes location badge for Kolkata, India.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header component with logo, site title, and navigation menu (Home, Products, Admin Panel). Handles client-side routing with custom navigation handler and active route highlighting.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero banner section with gradient background, promotional text for fashion and jewellery products, call-to-action buttons, and trust badges. Includes smooth scroll to products section.
frontend/src/components/OptimizedImage.t: Performance-optimized image component with lazy loading, intersection observer for viewport detection, WebP format support with PNG fallback, responsive sizes, and error handling with fallback chain.
frontend/src/components/PageModal.tsx: Modal component for displaying static pages (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Contact) with default content, scrollable body, and close functionality.
frontend/src/components/PasswordStrength: Password strength indicator component with visual progress bar, color-coded strength levels (weak/medium/strong), and feedback messages for password validation requirements.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Product grid component with filtering by category and price range, memoized product cards showing images, pricing, discounts, and Amazon affiliate links. Includes loading states and filter UI with collapsible sections.
frontend/src/components/SocialProof.tsx: Displays customer testimonials and a rotating carousel of recent purchases with star ratings, using hardcoded sample data for social proof.
frontend/src/components/Spinner.tsx: A simple SVG-based loading spinner component with customizable className and accessibility attributes.
frontend/src/components/TrustBadges.tsx: Renders trust badge images (Kolkata-based, Amazon Associates, secure checkout, money-back guarantee, SSL) with configurable layout (horizontal/vertical) and bilingual alt text.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Zustand store with persistence for managing user authentication state including session tokens, username, and 24-hour session expiration logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendAuth.ts: React Query mutations for user registration, authentication, and logout operations with toast notifications and session management integration.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts: Provides two debounce utilities: one for debouncing values and another for debouncing callback functions with configurable delay (default 300ms).
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for backend canister interactions including admin checks, product queries (all, by category, fashion), filtering, and mutations for creating/updating/deleting products with optimized caching.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom design tokens for light/dark themes using gold and navy color scheme with WCAG AA+ compliance, plus custom utilities for card hover effects and price range sliders.
frontend/src/lib/web-vitals.d.ts: TypeScript type definitions for the web-vitals library, defining Metric interface and report handlers for Core Web Vitals (CLS, FID, FCP, LCP, TTFB).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient provider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication context.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin page component that handles authentication verification (both custom auth and Internet Identity), checks admin permissions, and conditionally renders login form or admin panel with access control.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Products listing page with a gradient header section and ProductGrid component displaying the complete product catalog.
frontend/src/pages/SitemapPage.tsx: Generates and renders an XML sitemap dynamically with URLs for home and products pages using the canister ID from environment variables.
frontend/src/utils/delayedScripts.ts: Utility to defer loading of third-party scripts until 3 seconds after page load to improve Core Web Vitals and initial render performance.
frontend/src/utils/passwordValidation.ts: Password validation utilities that check strength (weak/medium/strong), enforce requirements (length, character types), and validate password confirmation matching.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and functions to clear sensitive parameters from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes (using OKLCH color space), container settings, border radius variables, and integrating typography, container queries, and animation plugins.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite build configuration for a React app with ICP integration, defining development proxy settings, production build optimizations (terser minification, code splitting for React/UI/ICP vendors), and environment variable handling for DFX network and canister IDs.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document showing a fashion store admin application transitioning from hardcoded credentials to a secure username/password authentication system with pending features for password hashing, user registration, and session management.
